responsibilities.name: scoped penetration-test delivery
responsibilities.source_text: Take ownership of limited test areas under senior guidance.

responsibilities.name: multi-vector security engagements
responsibilities.source_text: Participate in technical, social, and physical security engagements.

responsibilities.name: offensive-security specialization
responsibilities.source_text: Develop focus areas such as web, mobile, cloud, Active Directory, initial access, social engineering, or physical access.

responsibilities.name: findings presentation
responsibilities.source_text: Prepare findings and present them with the project lead.

responsibilities.name: technical knowledge sharing
responsibilities.source_text: Share technical knowledge through articles or videos.

requirements.name: alignment with company mission
requirements.description: Alignment with the employer's stated mission and security approach.
requirements.source_text: Support the company's mission and security approach.

requirements.name: network and infrastructure knowledge
requirements.description: Several years of IT administration experience or equivalent independently acquired knowledge.
requirements.source_text: Have several years of IT administration experience or equivalent independently acquired knowledge of networks and infrastructure.

requirements.name: practical penetration-testing or red-team experience
requirements.source_text: Have practical penetration-testing or red-team experience. Accepted examples include CTFs, Hack The Box, a homelab, OSCP preparation, or documented personal projects.

requirements.name: initiative and responsibility
requirements.source_text: Demonstrate initiative, proactive thinking, and responsibility.

requirements.name: client communication and collaboration
requirements.description: Clear communication of technical risks and effective collaboration.
requirements.source_text: Communicate technical risks clearly to customers and collaborate well.

requirements.name: german
requirements.source_text: Speak German at minimum C1 and English at minimum B2.

requirements.name: english
requirements.source_text: Speak German at minimum C1 and English at minimum B2.

requirements.name: security-review eligibility
requirements.description: Eligibility may be needed for certain classified assignments.
requirements.source_text: Some classified engagements may require eligibility for a security review.

requirements.name: offensive-security certification
requirements.description: A recognized offensive-security certification or comparable qualification.
requirements.source_text: Offensive-security certifications such as OSCP, CRTP, CRTO I/II, HTB CPTS, or comparable qualifications are desirable.

application_rules.name: genuine applicant input
application_rules.description: AI assistance is permitted, but the application must represent the applicant.
application_rules.source_text: AI may be used as a tool, but the application must contain genuine personal input.

application_rules.name: targeted application
application_rules.description: The candidate should apply only where the position genuinely fits.
application_rules.source_text: Apply only to positions that genuinely match the candidate.
